parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The name of the Microservices Engine (MSE) namespace that you want to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse query-all-swimming-lane-group --namespace default --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse QueryAllSwimmingLaneGroup --region cn-hangzhou --AcceptLanguage zh --Namespace default
